gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-krona-one: Expressive and a bit wild, Funnel Display draws its letters like looped spaghetti, one marker width throughout. Then Krona One takes over with wide, loosely spaced lowercase that has the heft of cast iron capitals, so a long passage moves slowly and sturdily.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-magra: Magra has a big-bodied feel in every lowercase word, and it keeps a straightforward, businesslike manner. Magra then stands beside Funnel Display, whose lines look traced with one marker tip, so the heading loops and the text stays solid.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-major-mono-disp: Major Mono Display glows like neon glass, with tube-like strokes and wide sidebearings. Under Funnel Display's looping marker lines, a long passage in this monospace would read slowly, precise and spaced out, one fixed-width character after another.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-martian-mono: Structured and code-like, Martian Mono spaces its letters far apart. Give this monospace a modest size and its generous curves stay clear beneath Funnel Display's commanding, looping heading, which needs no help from the body.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-matemasie: Funnel Display's open, spaghetti-like lines look drawn with a single pen, never closing up on themselves. Matemasie, a plain sans with broad gaps and tiny entry points, feels tighter and more shut beside it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-menbere: Menbere stacks its lowercase tall, like rolled cord, and keeps a quiet, clean manner. Over a long passage Menbere stays easy and upright, a plain sans next to Funnel Display's heading, which looks like thin steel rod bent into every letter.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-mitr: Rope-like lines bent into tubing give Funnel Display a commanding, expressive look at once. And Mitr, a contemporary sans-serif with almost no gap between x-height and cap height, keeps the text compact and friendly, while the heading earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-momo-trust-disp: Funnel Display draws every letter with a constant-width pen line, expressive and a little commanding in its looping shapes. Momo Trust Display, a plain sans with drifting, generous letters, gives it room.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-mukta: Mukta reads clean and upright, its small letters tall-bodied and unfussy. Mukta would feel oversized if the body went large, and Funnel Display would lose its pen-tip swagger if it shrank too far.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-mukta-mahee: Stencil-cut letters of one steady width mark Funnel Display. Mukta Mahee, a plain sans with chunky, tall lowercase, is the friendly counterweight, and the strongest thing here is how sturdy that body feels under a lively heading.
